notes.title: MotoGP™14 Season Pass available!
notes.content:
MotoGP™14 Season Pass available!
The complete set of MotoGP™14 DLC is now available. Enhance your racing experience with exclusive download contents that will add more in-game feature! 

Can't make a decision? Buy the MotoGP™14 Season Pass and have access to all the DLC contents released!

Here's a list of the available DLC:

MotoGP™14 Laguna Seca Red Bull US Grand Prix DLC 
MotoGP™14 Red Bull Rookies Cup DLC
MotoGP™ 14 Donington Park Circuit DLC

notes.title: MotoGP™ 14 Donington Park Circuit DLC now available!
notes.content:
MotoGP™ 14 Donington Park Circuit DLC is now available!
Complete your racing experience with exclusive download contents that will add more in-game feature! 

MotoGP™ 14 Donington Park Circuit DLC

This new downloadable content adds the Donington Park British GP to your selectable tracks to Grand Prix, Championship – offline game modes – and all online modes, with the exception of Sprint Season.

notes.title: MotoGP™14 Red Bull Rookies Cup DLC now available!
notes.content:
MotoGP™14 Red Bull Rookies Cup DLC is now available on Steam™
Complete your racing experience with exclusive download contents that will add more in-game feature! 

MotoGP™14 Red Bull Rookies Cup DLC

This new downloadable content adds a new category to the already existing ones and makes the Rookies Cup riders available in all game modes, except Career and Sprint Season.

The riders’ roster will be updated with:

64 - Bo Bendsneyder (Netherlands)
40 - Darryn Binder (South Africa)
99 - Enzo Boulom (France)
94 - Simon Danilo (France)
2 - Fabio Di Giannantonio (Italy)
41 - Marc Garcia (Spain)
13 - Martin Gbelec (Czech Republic)
17 - Oscar Gutierrez (Spain)
14 - Bruno Palazzese Ieraci (Italy)
12 - Lyvann Luchel (Martinique)
29 - Stefano Manzi (Italy)
88 - Jorge Martin Almoguera (Spain)
5 - Jaume Masia (Spain)
7 - Aris Michail (Germany)
74 - Soushi Mihara (Japan)
36 - Joan Mir Mayrata (Spain)
96 - Manuel Pagliani (Italy)
6 - Corentin Perolari (France)
28 - Bradley Callum Ray (United Kingdom)
54 - Toprak Razgatlioglu (Turkey)
9 - Robert Schotman (Netherlands)
45 - Olly Simpson (Australia)
21 - Hanro Van Rooyen (South Africa)
76 - Makar Yurchenko (Russia)

and KTM RC 250 R Bike.

notes.title: Available the first patch for MotoGP™14 Videogame
notes.content:
Milestone releases the first patch of MotoGP™14 Videogame

The patch is available for all the videogame platforms and Steam™ users will download it automatically starting from today.

Here you can find the OFFICIAL CHANGELOG:

Fixed tyre compound texture color
Fixed AI qualification times
Fixed winning picture in magazine 
Fixed engine sound during free camera
Fixed ideal trajectory toggle
Fixed Safety Car skid marks and particles
Improved Safety Car engine sound
